description: HTML file that includes JavaScript code for creating and managing UI components such as images, canvas, menus, and a menubar using the Isomorphic SmartClient framework. It provides a visual example of a menubar with functionalities to resize, move, and toggle visibility of a widget.

methods.name: moveUp
methods.description: Moves the widget upward by 20 pixels if it is not too close to the top boundary.

methods.name: moveRight
methods.description: Moves the widget to the right by 20 pixels if it does not exceed the right boundary.

methods.name: moveDown
methods.description: Moves the widget downward by 20 pixels if it is not too close to the bottom boundary.

methods.name: moveLeft
methods.description: Moves the widget to the left by 20 pixels if it is not too close to the left boundary.
